datePattern.title: Date format pattern
datePattern.description: Java SimpleDateFormat style: yyyy MM dd HH mm ss SSS EEE a. Default: dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: UTC, a fixed offset like +08:00, or empty to use the system timezone from TZ (falls back to UTC+8 when unavailable).
